name: The Shell of Regret
visual_description: A squat, layered creature. Its spiraled eye is dim, its body slouched under unseen weight. Its shell is marked by past mouths—now closed.
existential_reflection: I live, but I do not *feel* alive. Mizontresh has not absolved me—only allowed me to remain. This form is what I’ve become: present, but never again *whole.*
